BiblicalUsage: Yaldûth is youth itself, the early days of life. Ecclesiastes tells the young man to rejoice in his youth but to know that God will bring every deed into judgment, and the psalm pictures God's people willing in the day of His power, fresh as the dew of youth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe youth is a gift to spend well, not to waste, because the days of youth are the days God watches.
